flags.description: One object per flag in the request, in its order.

flag.description: The flag's number, as the request gives it.

present.description: Do the current document's pages state this metric for the current quarter, under any label or wording?

previous_value.description: Does the previous document's page state this value for this metric for its quarter?

reason_in_release.description: Do the current document's pages say that this metric is no longer reported, is now reported differently or elsewhere, or why it is not reported?
